  • Method Details

    • showCalculatedRoute

      public void showCalculatedRoute(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> originStopVertex, com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> destinationStopVertex, List<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>> middleStops, Collection<org.javatuples.Quartet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop>,String,TransportColor,Double>> pathEdges, TransportMetrics totalTransportMetrics)
      Displays the calculated route details including the origin, destination, and the total transport metrics (distance, duration, and cost). This method also toggles the visibility of the bottom menus between tips and calculated route.
      Parameters:
      originStopVertex - The vertex representing the origin stop.
      destinationStopVertex - The vertex representing the destination stop.
      middleStops - The list of middle stops, if any, between the origin and destination.
      pathEdges - The collection of edges representing the path between the stops (each including the route color, route label, and distance).
      totalTransportMetrics - The total transport metrics for the calculated route (distance, duration, and cost).
